The paper under review presents a novel, holistic framework for multi-step retrosynthesis that significantly differentiates itself from traditional And-Or tree expansion methods. The core contribution involves a single LLM call guided by molecular-similarity-based RAG, followed by a sophisticated iterative refinement loop using expert feedback models. The results are compelling: a 79.5% route round-trip validity for GPT-4-turbo, approaching the 83.0% of the established SOTA, Retro\*, and a dramatic jump in reaction-level validity (51.64% to 89.81%) after refinement. The paper features an extensive empirical evaluation across multiple LLMs and backbones, honest diagnostics of failure modes, and a nuanced analysis of the trade-offs between domain knowledge and instruction following.
